title: Woman with Books by Water
description: A woman in a blue and pink robe stands on a stone wall beside water. She holds an open book in one hand and reaches toward floating books with the other.
prompt: a woman in a flowing blue and pink robe stands on a stone wall beside calm water at dusk, she holds an open book in one hand and reaches with the other toward floating open books that drift in the air near blossoming trees, an eclipse appears in the dark cloudy sky and its reflection shows in the water, glowing particles and petals float around, more open books rest on the stones in the foreground next to a crystal ball
